dsl.source:
%% ofk 1
architecture
title: Instavol

model {
  person Gebruiker [desc: "Bewaart en leest links, afbeeldingen en notities"]
  external Snelkoppeling [desc: "iOS/iPadOS/macOS-snelkoppeling Bewaar in Instavol", tech: Shortcuts]
  system Instavol [desc: "Persoonlijke bewaarplek voor links, afbeeldingen en notities"] {
    container Website [desc: "Pagina's: login, registreren, lijst, reader", tech: Next.js + React]
    container Proxy [desc: "Sessiecontrole op pagina's en API (niet op /api/share)", tech: Next.js proxy]
    container API [desc: "Route handlers: links, share, share-token, categories, tags, highlights, notes, auth", tech: Next.js route handlers]
    container Verwerking [desc: "Pagina ophalen, artikel-extractie, samenvatten en categoriseren", tech: TypeScript]
    store Database [cylinder, desc: "Neon Postgres, benaderd via de serverless HTTP-driver (@neondatabase/serverless, DATABASE_URL). 6 tabellen: links, link_contents, link_images, members, share_tokens, site_password (legacy). Index links_user_id_idx. Schema in lib/schema.ts, 8 migraties in /drizzle (drizzle-kit). Tests draaien op PGlite", tech: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM]
  }
  external NeonAuth [desc: "Accounts, sessies, wachtwoord herstellen", tech: Neon Auth]
  external Gemini [desc: "Samenvatting en categorie. Model: gemini-3.8-flash (standaard in lib/gemini.ts, te overschrijven met GEMINI_MODEL; REST v1beta generateContent)", tech: Gemini API]
  external Websites [desc: "Opgeslagen webpagina's"]
  external Vercel [desc: "Hosting van de app; Neon Postgres via de Vercel-integratie", tech: Vercel]

  Gebruiker -> Website : leest en beheert
  Gebruiker -> Snelkoppeling : deelt link, foto of notitie
  Snelkoppeling -> API : POST /api/share [tech: HTTPS + share-token]
  Website -> Proxy : elk verzoek
  Proxy -> NeonAuth : valideert sessie
  Website -> API : inloggen, registreren
  Proxy -> API : doorgelaten verzoek
  API -> NeonAuth : auth-calls doorgegeven, sessie opvragen
  API -> Database : leest en schrijft, controleert share-token (hash) en lidmaatschap
  API -> Verwerking : start na het antwoord (after())
  Verwerking -> Websites : haalt pagina op [tech: HTTPS]
  Verwerking -> Gemini : samenvatten en categoriseren [tech: HTTPS]
  Verwerking -> Database : slaat resultaat op
  Vercel -> Website : host
}
views {
  view context of Instavol
  view container of Instavol
}

dsl.source:
%% ofk 1
erd right
title: Neon Postgres: tabellen

links [blue] {
  id uuid pk
  user_id text null
  kind text not-null
  url text null
  title text null
  status text not-null
  summary text null
  category text null
  tags "text[]" not-null
  notes jsonb not-null
  highlights jsonb not-null
  error_message text null
  image_url text null
  byline text null
  published_at timestamp null
  reading_minutes integer null
  created_at timestamp not-null
  updated_at timestamp not-null
}
link_contents [green] {
  link_id uuid pk fk
  html text not-null
  updated_at timestamp not-null
}
link_images [green] {
  link_id uuid pk fk
  mime text not-null
  data bytea not-null
  updated_at timestamp not-null
}
members [orange] {
  user_id text pk
  created_at timestamp not-null
}
share_tokens [orange] {
  user_id text pk
  token_hash text unique not-null
  created_at timestamp not-null
}
site_password [gray] {
  id integer pk
  password_hash text not-null
  updated_at timestamp not-null
}

links ||--o| link_contents : "artikeltekst (cascade)"
links ||--o| link_images : "afbeelding (cascade)"
members ||..o{ links : "user_id (geen FK)"
members ||..o| share_tokens : "user_id (geen FK)"
